PETITION of New England Power Company d/b/a National Grid, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 72 for Determination Construction of a 115 kV Overhead Transmission Line Necessary and will serve the public Convenience and be consistent with the public Interest. Prepared direct testimony and supporing exhibits of witnesses in suport of the petition. The required Section 72 Checklist; Executed forms of Appearance of Counsel. Motion for the Consolidation of Related Petition. Motion of New England Power Company d/b/a National Grid for Confidential Treatment with respect to (i) certain proprietary cost information; and (ii) certain Critical Energy infrasctruture Information contained within the Testimony. By Bess Gorman. DPU 09-136
